# prior_art/ — the papers EXP-001 was checked against

Full texts read for the M1 sweep (`report.md`, EXP-001). PDFs are the arXiv versions fetched on
2026-09-04; `.txt` files are `pdftotext -layout` extractions and are what the quotations in
`report.md` were taken from. Kept in the repo so the sweep can be re-audited offline.

**Not true in THIS repository, which is public.** The `.pdf` and `.txt` files are present in
the local working copy but deliberately untracked (see `.gitignore`) — these are published
papers whose licences do not generally grant redistribution, and one is an APS-copyrighted
RMP review. `SOURCES.md` is the tracked record. Fetch them from the arXiv identifiers above
to re-audit offline.

| file | paper |
|---|---|
| GHKW_1103.5366 | Gibbons, Houri, Kubizňák, Warnick — *Some spacetimes with higher rank Killing–Stäckel tensors*, PLB 700 (2011) 68 |
| GibbonsRugina_1107.5987 | Gibbons, Rugina — GC / Kovalevskaya / BENW pp-waves with higher rank Stäckel–Killing tensors, JMP 52 (2011) 122901 |
| Galajinsky_1201.3085 | Galajinsky — *Higher rank Killing tensors and Calogero model*, PRD 85 (2012) 085002 — the only published explicit rank-5 |
| CG_1503.02162 | Cariglia, Galajinsky — *Ricci-flat spacetimes admitting higher rank Killing tensors*, PLB 744 (2015) 320 — signature (2,q) |
| FG_1901.03699 | Fordy, Galajinsky — *Eisenhart lift of 2-dimensional mechanics*, EPJC 79 (2019) 301 — "no vacuum solution with higher rank KT is presently known" |
| GHKMS_2112.07649 | Gray, Hennigar, Kubizňák, Mann, Srivastava — generalized Lense–Thirring, JHEP 04 (2022) 070 |
| KS_2207.03474 | Kruglikov, Steneker — *Killing tensors in Koutras–McIntosh spacetimes*, CQG 39 (2022) 225005 |
| HeLi_2407.11178 | He, Li — *Spacetimes with prescribed Killing tensor symmetries*, PRD 110 (2024) 084076 |
| GOKK_2504.18287 | Gray, Odak, Krtouš, Kubizňák — *On a lower-dimensional Killing vector origin of irreducible Killing tensors*, JHEP 07 (2025) 098 |
| Bohlin_2603.15626 | Galajinsky — *The Bohlin variant of the Eisenhart lift*, arXiv:2603.15626 (2026) |

Abstract-only checks (no local copy) are listed in the EXP-001 reference list.
